title: Multimodal Shallow Alignment: Image-Channel Prefill Variation

original_idea.body: Test whether harmful content via the image channel bypasses text-side shallow safety in a small open VLM; test safe prefill. Single GPU.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Strong chain: whether the image channel bypasses text-side safety is a concrete medium-horizon risk as VLMs proliferate (level 4).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Run small open VLM across three conditions + refusal scoring; clear methodology, VLM handling adds modest difficulty (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (refusal-rate comparison across 3 conditions + prefill test), few dependencies (level 4).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly multimodal robustness extension on public small VLMs (level 4).

low_compute.reasoning: Small VLM inference is feasible but heavier than text-only; mid single-GPU (level 3).

novelty.reasoning: Multimodal jailbreaks studied but the image-prefill shallow-alignment variation may be partly open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Multimodal safety bypass studied; the shallow-alignment image-prefill angle may be open.
